# Jeffrey Jolly — Penetration Tester & Cybersecurity Analyst

## About
Jeffrey has 4+ years of experience in VAPT across web, API, mobile, thick client, network, cloud and AI/LLM systems. Currently a Cybersecurity Analyst at Tata Consultancy Services.
